_comment: Four training epochs over the same NYC yellow columns. The epoch literal only keeps the texts distinct; each statement is executed separately and reads the same projection.
1: SELECT 1 AS epoch, count(*) AS n, count(payment_type) AS n_pay, min(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS pickup_min, max(tpep_dropoff_datetime) AS dropoff_max, avg(passenger_count) AS pax, avg(trip_distance) AS dist, avg(RatecodeID) AS rate, avg(fare_amount) AS fare, avg(tip_amount) AS tip, avg(tolls_amount) AS tolls, avg(total_amount) AS total FROM nyc_yellow
